description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic physics theories and methods, applied physics theories, a strong mathematical basis, photoelectric display technology or computational physics, capable of teaching, applied research, technology development, and senior management in the field of physics, physical electronics and related fields. Relying on the provincial-level key discipline - Theoretical Physics and Modern Physics Institute, it has nano-technology research centre, and laboratories of information technology - microelectronics laboratory by the local and central government, as the basis of professional practice and teaching platform. It has overseas PhD teaching staff. There are 7 professors (including 2 of Chongqing Municipality "322 key personnel project", at level 2, 2 doctoral tutors), 6 associate professors and senior engineers. There are 2 specialties: photoelectric display technology and computational physics.

duration.text: The Applied Physics at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
